title: La Mer Azur Penthouse | KEY.co
description_expanded: Guests enjoy the full spectrum of indulgence with exclusive access to 1 Hotel & Homes South Beach’s world-class amenities. A private residence lobby, valet services, and a dedicated concierge team ensure effortless stays, while chauffeured electric vehicles add a touch of refinement to exploring the local area. From lounging by the pool to dining at award-winning restaurants, or unwinding at the eco-conscious spa, every moment is an invitation to luxurious living. Recognized by Conde Nast Traveler and included in the Hot List and Gold List, La Mer D'Azur promises an unforgettable South Beach experience. Perched on the top floor, this stunning penthouse redefines coastal luxury. With over 80 feet of uninterrupted ocean views visible through floor-to-ceiling windows, every corner of this four-bedroom retreat offers a front-row seat to the breathtaking beauty of South Beach. Accommodating up to eight guests, each bedroom and living area is designed to highlight the expansive beach and pool vistas. Modern touches like 4K Ultra High Definition Smart TVs blend seamlessly with the serene, elegant interiors, ensuring that relaxation and entertainment are always at your fingertips.
